_comment: Per-district TTS voice routing for Level 2 hometown sentences. null = Bucket A (internationally established anglicized name, stay on en-GB-SoniaNeural, speak English text as-is). A string value = Bucket B (everyday local name, no separate anglicized form — switch to si-LK-ThiliniNeural/SameeraNeural and speak this Sinhala-script spelling instead of the English text). This is a first-pass classification from general knowledge, not native-speaker-verified — correct entries directly here after listening tests, no code change needed for data corrections. CAUTION: Kandy and Batticaloa have DIFFERENT traditional Sinhala names (Maha Nuwara / Madakalapuwa) that must never be used as their entries here — that would substitute a different word, not fix pronunciation. Keys must exactly match auriva-frontend/src/constants/sriLankaDistricts.js (TASK-16).
